objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: adding the next column, whose $2^{j+1}$ strips consist of two identical copies of all preceding strips plus one parity interchange, preserves this alternative.
objection.witness: The invariant asserted for part (ii) is not proved. In particular, arbitrary cuts need not respect the mental strips of height $d$, and the text does not justify why adding the next column preserves either alternative or forces an entire odd strip to remain.
